about: A01 shot list for hybrid/run-clips.mjs, frames.mjs and spec.mjs. A Snap it. spot in the style of the airbnb it. films: a character-scale gag, then a pull-out to the room as a diorama with the wordmark.

shots.name: a01kitchen
shots.prompt: Very slow, very slight push-in, no zoom, no cuts. A stylized 3D animated character at a kitchen table at night, buried behind towering stacks of paper contracts. She lets out a long tired sigh and her shoulders drop. Then a soft swirl of glowing pale lavender sparkle dust rises from the table and spins around the paper stacks; the papers lift off the table one after another, flutter up into the air like a flock of birds and fly out of frame, until the table is tidy with only her laptop and camera. Her face lights up, she sits up and laughs with relief. Expressive animated performance, smooth character animation, warm lamp light. Same face, same clothes, same kitchen, nothing morphs. Feels playful and a little magical, a weight lifted.

shots.name: a01m1
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. The camera pulls back smoothly and quickly, up and away from the character at the kitchen table, revealing the whole kitchen as a small cutaway dollhouse room sitting on a pale lavender studio backdrop. The character stays exactly where she is at the table, nobody walks, floats or grows. Only the camera moves. No cuts, no fades, no morphing, no dissolve.

shots.name: a01diorama
shots.prompt: Very slow, very slight push-in; the whole cutaway room stays in frame the entire time; no zoom, no cuts. A small stylized 3D animated character stands in a cutaway dollhouse kitchen on a pale lavender backdrop, arms raised, then does a happy little hop and spins once; a few tiny sheets of paper float up and away above the room and fade into the pale sky. The pendant lamp glows softly. The room does not change shape. Same face, same clothes, nothing drifts. Clean pale backdrop throughout, crisp, no haze, no fog. Feels light and satisfied.
